macro.waffle_shop.line_total_cents.name: line_total_cents
macro.waffle_shop.line_total_cents.macro_sql:
"""Project-wide currency macros."""


def line_total_cents(price_cents: str, quantity: str) -> str:
    """Calculate line total cents from a unit price and quantity."""
    return f"{price_cents} * {quantity}"

macro.waffle_shop.cents_to_dollars.name: cents_to_dollars
macro.waffle_shop.cents_to_dollars.macro_sql:
"""Currency formatting macros."""


def cents_to_dollars(column: str) -> str:
    """Convert a cents integer column to a dollars decimal with two decimal places."""
    return f"ROUND(({column}) / 100.0, 2)"
